Russian airstrikes | Eight killed and wound in border village with Iskenderun

SOHR activists documented the death of two civilians and the injury of five others in two airstrikes by Russian jets that targeted a “poultry farm” on the outskirts of town of Kfardaryan on Syria border with Iskenderun, north of Idlib.

SOHR activists have just reported that Russian fighter jets executed two airstrikes on the outskirts of Kansafra and Al-Bara in Jabal Al-Zawiyah in the southern countryside of Idlib. However, no casualties were reported.

This bombardment coincided with flights by several Russian fighter jets over the “de-escalation zone“.

Yesterday, SOHR activists monitored 12 airstrikes carried out by Russian fighter jets on “Putin-Erdogan” area, targeting Al-Sheikh Bahr area on the outskirts of the northern city of Idlib.

These airstrikes also bombed the vicinity of the areas of “Barisha, Kafr Arouk, Maarat Masrin, Darat Azza, Sheikh Bahr” in the western countryside of Aleppo, and northern Idlib.
